```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  bump-progressive-rollout-version:
    if: |
      github.event.comment.body == '/bump-progressive-rollout-version' ||
      startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/bump-progressive-rollout-version ')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r dev-requirements.txt

      - name: Run airbyte-ci connectors bump-version
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
        run: |
          airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          script: |
            const commentBody = `✅ Bumped connector version with RC for progressive rollout. Next steps: run tests, merge the PR, and enable progressive rollout in metadata.yaml.`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: commentBody
            });
```
